## Checklist

- [ ] CI checks pass locally (`./mvnw spotless:apply verify`; `npm run format`, `lint`,
      `typecheck`, `test`, `build`)
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] Docs updated: `docs/api.md` (API), `docs/metrics.md` (any new or changed number), README
      (user-visible features)
- [ ] Any new GitHub requests are capped, cached and listed in the cost table in `docs/api.md`
- [ ] Missing data shows as unavailable, not `0`; no scores or rankings of people
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data (such as email addresses) in code, logs or fixtures
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
